UnknownUser: The user does not exist or the bot cannot see them.
Check the id. The person may have deleted their account.
DirectMessagesRestricted: The person's privacy settings refuse this DM.
Do not retry. Reach them in a server channel.
DirectMessagesPaused: The server paused DMs between its members.
Do not retry. A moderator lifts the pause.
OfficialAccount: An official Zrzur account cannot be replied to, reacted to, pinned or reported.
UnknownChannel: The channel is gone or the bot cannot see it.
Check the id and that the bot has View Channel.
UnknownMessage: The message is gone, or it is not in this channel.
UnknownAttachment: A file id in the body does not exist or was already used.
Upload the file again. Each upload can be used once.
CannotDeleteMessage: The message cannot be deleted, for example one this interaction did not create.
Delete only what your bot wrote, or get Manage Messages.
CannotEditMessage: A bot can only edit its own messages.
TooManyAttachments: The message has more files than `max`.
Send the files in several messages.
TooManyEmbeds: The message has more embeds than `max`.
TooManyReplies: The message replies to more messages than `max`.
TooManyChannels: The server reached its channel limit, `max`.
TooManyChannelWebhooks: The channel reached its limit of webhooks.
Delete a webhook in this channel.
TooManyServerWebhooks: The server reached its limit of webhooks.
Delete a webhook in this server.
RateLimited: A webhook sent too much. The body has `retry_after` in milliseconds.
Wait that long, then send again.
ForumThreadRequired: A webhook posted to a forum without a thread.
ThreadsDisabled: The server switched threads off. What exists stays readable.
Do not retry. Only the server can switch them back on.
ForumsDisabled: The server switched forums off. What exists stays readable.
Do not retry. Only the server can switch them back on.
PluginsDisabled: Plugins are switched off on this server. No plugin route answers while they are off.
Do not retry. Plugins come back only when the server turns them on.
EmptyMessage: The message has no content, embeds, attachments or components.
PayloadTooLarge: The message is over a size limit.
Shorten the text or the embeds.
InSlowmode: The channel has slowmode and the bot wrote too soon. The body has `retry_after`.
Wait, or give the bot Bypass Slowmode. This is a refusal, not a rate limit.
UnknownServer: The server does not exist or the bot is not in it.
Check the id. Forget a server when you get `ServerDelete`.
InvalidRole: The role does not exist in this server.
Banned: This user is banned from the server.
A moderator removes the ban first.
AlreadyInServer: The bot is already in this server.
CannotTimeoutYourself: The target of the timeout is the bot itself.
TooManyEmoji: The server reached its emoji limit, `max`.
TooManyRoles: The server reached its role limit, `max`.
UnknownApplication: Check the id: an application id is the bot's user id.
ApplicationNotInstalled: Someone used a bot that is not in this server.
Install the bot in the server.
ApplicationOffline: The bot was suspended or switched off, so it receives nothing.
SignedDeliveryRejected: Your HTTP interaction address failed its test. `reason` says why.
UnknownCommand: The command id is unknown, or it was deleted.
CommandAlreadyExists: A command with this name and type already exists in this scope.
Use `PUT` to replace the list, or edit the command.
TooManyCommands: The limit of `max` commands of this type in one scope is reached.
UnknownInteraction: The interaction id or token is wrong.
Use the values from `InteractionCreate` as they are.
InteractionExpired: The 3 seconds to acknowledge, or the 15 minutes of the token, are over.
Acknowledge sooner. Use `DeferredMessage` for slow work.
InteractionAlreadyAcknowledged: This interaction already has its first answer.
Use a follow-up, or edit the original.
TooManyFollowups: The limit of `max` follow-ups for one interaction is reached.
Edit a message, or send a normal message.
IsBot: This route is for people. Bots are refused.
Do it another way. The reference marks what bots can use.
BotIsPrivate: Only the owner can install a private bot.
Sign in as the owner, or make the bot public.
MissingPermission: The bot lacks the permission named in `permission`.
Give the bot that permission, or tell the person.
MissingUserPermission: The person the bot acts for lacks the permission in `permission`.
MissingIntent: The route or connection needs the intent named in `intent`.
Switch it on in the Developer Portal and ask for it when you connect.
MasqueradeNameTaken: The masquerade name copies another member.
BotNeedsVerification: An unverified bot stops at 100 servers.
VerificationRequired: The server's verification level refuses this member for now. `requirement` says why.
Wait, or ask the server's moderators.
AutoModBlocked: The server's AutoMod rule `rule` refused the message.
Change the text. Do not retry the same text.
RulesNotAccepted: The member has not accepted the server's rules.
Tell them to accept the rules.
InvitesPaused: Do not retry. A moderator lifts the pause.
NotElevated: The target ranks at or above the bot, or the role is above the bot's top role.
NotPrivileged: The bot's rank is too low for this change.
CannotGiveMissingPermissions: The bot tried to give a permission it does not have itself.
Give the bot that permission first.
NotOwner: Only the owner can do this.
IsElevated: The target ranks too high for this.
InternalError: Wait and retry with a growing delay. Report it if it stays.
InvalidOperation: The request is not valid in this state, for example a `Modal` as the answer to a form.
Check the rules of this route.
InvalidCredentials: The token, password or ticket is wrong.
InvalidProperty: A field combination is not allowed here.
InvalidSession: The token is missing or wrong, or the bot was suspended.
Stop and check the token. Retrying does not help.
NotAuthenticated: The route needs a token and got none.
DuplicateNonce: The same `nonce` was used for a different request.
Use a new value for each new message.
NotFound: The route or the object does not exist.
Check the path and the ids.
FailedValidation: The body breaks a limit or a rule. `error` says which in one line, and `fields` lists each field with its rule.
Fix the body. Do not retry the same request.
LiveKitUnavailable: Voice is not available on this server.
NotAVoiceChannel: The channel is not a voice channel.
AlreadyConnected: The bot is already in this voice channel.
NotConnected: The member is not in a voice channel.
UnknownNode: The voice node does not exist.
FeatureDisabled: This server has the feature named in `feature` switched off.
Do not retry. Self-hosted servers switch it on in their configuration.
HeaderTooLarge: A header is too large, for example the audit log reason.
ProxyError: The link or media proxy could not fetch the address.
Check that the address is public.
FileTooLarge: The file is over the limit of its tag, `max`.
ImageProcessingFailed: The image could not be read.
NoEmbedData: The link has no preview data.
IncorrectData: The stored data does not match. `with` names it.
DatabaseError: A database call failed on the server.
Wait and retry with a growing delay.
VosoUnavailable: The old voice service is unavailable.
RenderFail: The server could not render a template.
LabelMe: Retry later. Report it if it stays.
ContactSupport: The server wants a person to contact support. `msg` says why.
Show the message to the owner.
InvalidFlagValue: A flag has a value the server does not know.
TooManySounds: Remove a sound first. `max` is the limit.
SoundAlreadyAdded: This library sound is on the server's soundboard already.
SoundLibraryUnavailable: The sound library is not ready yet.
TooManySpeakers: The stage has as many speakers as it may have.
Move a speaker back to the audience first. `max` is the limit.
PollEnded: The poll is over: no more votes, and it cannot be ended again.

AlreadyOnboarded: The account already has a username.
AgeNotDeclared: The account has not declared its age.
People only: finish it in the app.
InvalidUsername: The username has characters that are not allowed.
DiscriminatorChangeRatelimited: The name tag changed too recently.
TooManyPendingFriendRequests: Too many friend requests are pending.
CannotRemoveYourself: The group owner cannot remove themselves.
AlreadyInGroup: The user is already in the group.
NotInGroup: The user is not in the group.
CantCreateServers: This account cannot create servers. Bots never can.
Create the server as a person.
TooManyServers: The account reached its server limit.
VanityUnavailable: The server cannot have a custom address.
TooManyCommunityItems: The creator reached the limit of items.
MissingPlatformPermission: This needs a Zrzur staff permission.
ProfileTextFiltered: The platform word list stopped this text.
TooManyReports: Too many reports in a short time.
TooManySupercharges: The limit of Wings is reached.
TooManyBotCreations: The account made 7 bots in the last 7 days.
Wait until `resets_at`, then create the bot.
NotOnDiscover: The server is not on Discover.
ReachedMaximumBots: The account reached its limit of bots.
BlockedByShield: The sign-up shield refused the request.
UnverifiedAccount: The account's e-mail is not verified.
EmailFailed: The e-mail could not be sent.
InvalidToken: The link or code is wrong or has expired.
MissingInvite: This server needs an invite to sign up.
CompromisedPassword: The password is on a list of leaked passwords.
DisallowedMFAMethod: This check is not allowed here.
AgeRequirementNotMet: The account is too young for this.
AgeRestricted: The content is limited by age.
TooManyServerEvents: The server has as many scheduled events as it may have.
ForwardMatureContent: A message from a mature channel can only be forwarded into another mature channel.
